_readme: Edit this file to update the monthly calendar, activities, milestones, collaborators, sponsors and FAQ, then run: node scripts/render-content.mjs. Text fields may contain simple HTML (<a>, <strong>, <em>). Only add facts with a source or confirmed by the owner. NEW MONTH: add an object to calendar.months (copy the November one), list each program day under 'events' (date, kind, start, end; 'venue' only if it isn't the usual room), and the render script rebuilds the calendar, the weekly summary, the hero 'Times', the Help assistant's schedule answers and the Event structured data. 'status' for activities: 'regular', 'project' (time-limited workshop series), 'event' (one-off or annual). 'icon' values are sprite ids (#a-...) in public/index.html; icons are decorative.

featuredProject.title: Cultural Arts for Holistic Healing of Mind, Body and Spirit
featuredProject.text: A workshop series for seniors in South Markham, facilitated by Island Breeze with ACSA Community Services and supported by United Way Greater Toronto. From January to July, members drummed, wrote, danced, sculpted and celebrated together.

joinSteps.title: Call or email us
joinSteps.text: Call 416-319-7763, or email islandbreezeseniors@gmail.com and we’ll reply. You can also send a message below and ask us to call you back.

joinSteps.title: Ask your questions
joinSteps.text: Ask what's on this month, where to meet, and anything else you'd like to know before you come.

joinSteps.title: Plan your first visit
joinSteps.text: Pick an activity to try first. If anything would make your visit easier, just let us know when you call or email.

faq.a: Island Breeze describes its programs as serving adults aged 55 and older in Markham. If you're not sure whether a program is right for you or someone you care for, call 416-319-7763 or email islandbreezeseniors@gmail.com.
Call 416-319-7763 or email islandbreezeseniors@gmail.com and we'll talk you through it. You can also send us a message below and ask for a call back.

In the Amenity Room at Hagerman Corners Community Homes, 4460 14th Avenue, Markham. Some events meet elsewhere (for example, Seniors Circle on November 18 is at Milliken Church, 3 Clayton Drive), and the calendar always shows the location. Get directions (opens Google Maps in a new tab).
Costs can vary by activity. Call 416-319-7763 or email islandbreezeseniors@gmail.com to ask about the activity you're interested in.
Our mission includes older adults and their caregivers in Markham. Call 416-319-7763 or email islandbreezeseniors@gmail.com to talk about coming together, so we can plan the visit with you.
{{weekly}} Every date and time is in this month’s calendar. Questions? Call Charmaine at 416-319-7763.

faq.q: What accessibility or transportation arrangements are available?
faq.a: Please call 416-319-7763 or email islandbreezeseniors@gmail.com before your visit so we can talk through access, mobility needs and how you'll get there.

Island Breeze was founded by Charmaine. It’s a not-for-profit run by a volunteer board, with the help of volunteers and community facilitators. For program information, call Charmaine at 416-319-7763 or email islandbreezeseniors@gmail.com.
